name: Modern WebKit backport for Safari 7 on OS X Mavericks

mentions.name: Modern WebKit backport for Safari 7 on OS X Mavericks
mentions.description: A backport of the modern 2026 WebKit framework to Safari 7 on OS X Mavericks (2013), making the legacy browser able to access the modern web again, including webapps like Figma. Claude wrote the code; the author's role was deciding larger infrastructure questions and finding and reproducing bugs.
mentions.problem: Safari 7 on OS X Mavericks (2013) is an ancient browser that can no longer access the modern web.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm backporting the modern 2026 WebKit framework to work with Safari 7 on OS X Mavericks, from 2013.

With the updated frameworks in place, this ancient browser becomes able to access the modern web again! Even webapps like Figma work!
